question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

P_ _N_OM_ _ _MNP
solution:
Given series: P_ _N_OM_ _ _MNP

By checking options,

I. OMPNPO → P **O M** N - **P** O M **N - P** **O** M N - P

 
• Here ***POMN*** is repeated.
